tasks.prompt: Use PowerShell to simulate a harmless keystroke (ScrollLock toggle twice) to prevent Windows 11 screen lock due to company policy. Run: powershell -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait('{SCROLLLOCK}'); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait('{SCROLLLOCK}')". This keeps the system active without interfering with user work.
